title: Good things to eat, as suggested by Rufus: a collection of practical recipes for preparing meats, game, fowl, fish, puddings, pastries, etc.
description: A book of recipes written by Rufus Estes, a formerly enslaved Black man who went on to work for the Pullman Company and other railroads before being named chef of the subsidiary companies of the United States Steel Corporation in Chicago.
